text:
[LSIG.1.5.4] `integral` is admitted on `Float` and `Int` slots, under
`sliding` and `all_time`. It is not admitted on `Bool` (use
`active_fraction`) nor under `sample`. The compiler must reject those. Its
`tumbling` form is refused in this edition with every other `tumbling` line
([LSER.14.4.5]).
